address: Avenue de la Paix 12, Geneva, 1202, Switzerland
bio: Just behind the United Nations, Geneva's hotel management school (EHG) invites the general public to step into its restaurant, which is devoted to upholding traditions of excellence. In an elegant, historical setting and under the eagle eye of their teachers, students craft a seasonal lineup that combines respect for the ingredient with textbook technique. Examples include a cappuccino of celeriac with crunchy hazelnuts and brioche bread, or a roast breast of duck flanked by a gutsy gravy and melt-in-the-mouth carrots. On the dessert side, an explosive chocolate bar and pear sorbet add a decadent final flourish to your meal. The perfect place to sample pedigree recipes of flawlessly cooked traditional fare at extremely attractive prices for Geneva....
